args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List
June 10-20, 2024

Essential Documents:
- Passport/ID
- Flight tickets/boarding passes
- Hotel reservation confirmations
- Travel insurance documents
- Credit cards and cash
- Emergency contact information

Clothing:
- Swimwear (multiple sets)
- Light, breathable clothing
- Casual outfits for dinners
- Light jacket or sweater for cooler evenings
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Sandals/flip flops
- Hat/cap for sun protection
- Sunglasses

Beach & Water Activities:
- Beach towels
- Reef-safe sunscreen (SPF 50+)
- After-sun lotion/aloe vera
- Waterproof phone case
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel, fins)
- Beach bag
- Waterproof dry bag for valuables

Hiking & Outdoor Activities:
- Hiking boots/shoes
- Moisture-wicking socks
- Lightweight hiking pants/shorts
- Quick-dry t-shirts
- Rain jacket (for unexpected showers)
- Daypack/backpack
- Water bottle/hydration system
- Insect repellent

Electronics:
- Camera with extra batteries/memory cards
- Phone charger
- Portable power bank
- Universal travel adapter
- Headphones

Toiletries:
- Personal medications
- Prescription sunglasses if needed
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Shampoo and conditioner
- Body wash
- Deodorant
- Hairbrush/comb
- Razor
- Makeup (if applicable)

Miscellaneous:
- Reusable water bottle
- Snacks for day trips
- Books/magazines for relaxation
- Travel pillow for flights
- Small first aid kit
- Hand sanitizer
- Face masks (if required)
- Laundry bag for dirty clothes

Special Items for Planned Activities:
- Formal attire for luau (June 16)
- Comfortable clothes for Pearl Harbor visit (June 14)
- Shopping list for Ala Moana Center (June 19)
